newsitem.title: POLAND: BIG unit cleared to buy Gdanski stake.
newsitem.headline: BIG unit cleared to buy Gdanski stake.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland has allowed a subsidiary of BIG bank, Bel Leasing sp. z o.o., to increase its stake in Bank Gdanski SA to between 10 and 20 percent, BIG said in a statement on Tuesday.
BIG and its subsidiaries together hold 24 percent of Gdanski, including eight percent held by Bel Leasing.

Last week, HSBC Investment Bank in London released the Polish treasury from a lockup agreement under the terms of its issue of global depositary receipts, which prevented the state from selling further shares until December 18.
HSBC, managing the issue, said Poland's treasury would now sell a 39.94 percent stake in Bank Gdanski via a public tender.
